purpose: ia-use-levels-20261014 Lane D: E2E of restored results_innovations_use/result_actors on DEV (Marc Schut questions, 13 Oct)

questions.text: All 2025 innovation use results should have a 0-9 Innovation Use level reported along side of innovation use numbers (# farmers). For all 2025 quality-assured Innovation Use results: how many have a current 0-9 Innovation Use level, how many report use numbers (e.g. number of farmers or other users), and what is the distribution across use levels 0-9?
For result codes R25015 and R25028, what is the current innovation use level (0-9) and how many users were reported?
How many innovations were reported in 2025 (quality-assured), split W1/W2 vs W3/bilateral, and how many of them are Innovation Use results?

For the "Proven" candidates from Africa: please consider 2025 Innovation Use results with a current use level of 7-9. List the top 10 by number of users, with a dedicated use level column (current 0-9 use level) and a column with the current use reported (e.g. 10000 farmers).
